profile_text: With a focus on scientific and technical activities, this Düsseldorf-based firm has experienced rapid growth of 108.6% since its baseline, driven by its expertise in vaccine development and immunology. As a leading player in the biotechnology sector, it has expanded its workforce to 146 employees in 2024, solidifying its position as a scaler in the industry. Located at Eichsfelder Strasse 11, the company continues to advance its research and development efforts, leveraging its strong management and board of directors to drive innovation.
